# cli-forge

CLI tool for working with cli-forge based CLI's.

This document describes the CLI commands and options for AI agent consumption.

Usage: cli-forge

Options:
  --help (aliases: -h) <boolean>
    Show help for the current command
  --version <boolean>
    Show the version number for the CLI

Subcommands:
  generate-documentation - Generate documentation for the given CLI
  init - Generate a new CLI

  ## cli-forge generate-documentation
  Generate documentation for the given CLI

  Usage: cli-forge generate-documentation <cli>

  Positional Arguments:
    <cli> - string (required)
      Path to the cli that docs should be generated for.

  Options:
    --help (aliases: -h) <boolean>
      Show help for the current command
    --version <boolean>
      Show the version number for the CLI
    --output (aliases: -o) <string>
      Where should the documentation be output?
      Default: "docs"
    --format <string>
      What format should the documentation be output in?
      Default: "md"
      Valid values: json, md
    --export <string>
      The name of the export that contains the CLI instance. By default, docs will be generated for the default export.
    --tsconfig <string>
      Specifies the `tsconfig` used when loading typescript based CLIs.
    --llms <boolean>
      Generate an llms.txt file describing the CLI for AI agents.
      Default: true

  Examples:
    $ cli-forge generate-documentation ./bin/my-cli
    $ cli-forge generate-documentation ./bin/my-cli --format json
    $ cli-forge generate-documentation ./bin/my-cli --export mycli

  ## cli-forge init
  Generate a new CLI

  Usage: cli-forge init <cliName>

  Positional Arguments:
    <cliName> - string (required)
      Name of the CLI to generate.

  Options:
    --help (aliases: -h) <boolean>
      Show help for the current command
    --version <boolean>
      Show the version number for the CLI
    --output (aliases: -o) <string>
      Where should the CLI be created?
    --format <string>
      What format should the CLI be in?
      Default: "ts"
      Valid values: js, ts
    --initialVersion (aliases: --initial-version) <string>
      Initial version used when creating the package.json for the new CLI.
      Default: "0.0.1"
